# apollo_subgraph (Data Source)

Reads GraphOS subgraph registration metadata for a specific graph variant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apollo_subgraph" "products" {
  graph_id = "inventory"
  variant  = "production"
  name     = "products"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `graph_id` (String) Owning graph identifier.
- `name` (String) Subgraph name to look up.
- `variant` (String) Variant that owns the subgraph registration.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic stable identifier in the form `graph_id:variant:name`.
- `revision` (String) Current GraphOS revision identifier for the registration, when available.
- `routing_url` (String) Routing URL returned by GraphOS.
